blocks.text: Clayton homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Clayton, September 2026. Detached houses: 34 listed at month end and 10 sold in September, a sales ratio of 29% (a sellers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 96 listed at month end and 20 sold in September, a sales ratio of 21% (a sellers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 36 sold over 4 months against an average of 42.5 listed, about 4.7 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was August with 10 sold. Condos and townhomes: 96 sold over 4 months against an average of 99.8 listed, about 4.2 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 29 sold.
